programme.title: Petta
programme.desc: In a bid to save his best friend's son Anwar, hostel warden Kaali goes against local goons. However, everything goes haywire when he is forced to face his past.

programme.title: Diesel
programme.desc: A driven and determined young man is forced to confront ruthless and corrupt authorities after becoming ensnared in the dangerous web of the diesel mafia.

programme.title: Mufti
programme.desc: Gana, a police officer, must go undercover to find and kill Bhairathi Ranagal, a crime lord. However, when he realises that Bhairathi's intentions are good, he needs to decide his next step.

programme.title: Bal Ganesh 3
programme.desc: Dhoti, Topi and Suit Boot are more than happy to oblige when a group of alien kids come over to listen to adventure stories about their favourite Bal Ganesh.

programme.title: Crazy Singh
programme.desc: Bittu, a village simpleton, falls in love with a modern Saumya. Chaos ensues when their contrasting families meet to fix their marriage.

programme.title: House No. 13
programme.desc: A family moves into a new home and experiences paranormal events. However, one by one, the family members start getting killed making the head of the family investigate the cause and stop the deaths.

programme.title: Bal Hanuman Return Of The Demon
programme.desc: Bal Hanuman and his friends join together to defeat the crocodile demon who has been brought to life in order to create havoc on Earth.

programme.title: Jaguar
programme.desc: Krishna, an orphan medical student, lives a seemingly ordinary life. However, unbeknownst to people, he is a vigilante named Jaguar who pursues a certain group of people in order to kill them.

programme.title: Daaku Maharaaj
programme.desc: A brave thief fights to survive and claim his territory. However, he battles powerful enemies, aiming to become a leader without a real kingdom.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: A ruthless politician and his criminal syndicate target a young girl for assassination. With her life in grave danger, an unexpected dog groomer steps forward to protect her.

programme.title: Custody
programme.desc: A police constable's life takes a drastic turn when he is entrusted with producing a criminal in court. While the mobster remains under his custody, Shiva must dodge every threat to keep him alive.

programme.title: The Raja Saab
programme.desc: RajaSaab's search for his estranged grandfather leads him to a haunted mansion. He learns that his grandfather Kanakaraju, an exorcist, has laid a trap to lure him.

programme.title: Siren
programme.desc: A mysterious girl arrives in Bristol Cove, a coastal town famous for its mermaid legends. Soon, predatory mermaids return to reclaim the ocean and spark a vicious battle with humanity.
